Guidance & outlook: So, even domestic business also I'm expecting a growth of about 15% to 20%.
We delivered revenue from the operations of INR430 million in Q1 FY27, which is representing a 13% Y-o-Y increase compared to the INR380 million in Q1 FY26.
If I see again, property, plant, and equipment, FY25 March -- as on FY25 March, our property, plant, equipment was INR641 million, and as on FY26, this was around INR594 million.
Growth & demand: So, that way, the amount of business that we are likely to get, and it is in the pipeline, is quite a lot, and we expect a minimum of 20% growth this year and maybe a little more than that in the further two years, because this year will go in capturing th e new OEMs and capturing the new business.
Otherwise, we are expecting definitely 20% growth, around 20% growth in this year.
But current revenue, as I told you, 20% growth is irrespective of this, and this will be additional growth.
Margins & costs: EBITDA, if I'm coming to Hy-Tech Engineers Limited September 22, 2026 CIN No. - L99999MH1978PLC020853 the EBITDA part, so EBITDA stood at INR84 million compared to the INR82 million in the corresponding quarter of the last year.
In the PPT presentation itself, slide 5 shows raw material cost fell as a share of sales, while employee cost rose 28.5%.
No, they are in the regular margin, but see, if you see, we are doing around 30% of export business where we are getting better margins, almost about 10% extra margins we are getting.
Capex & expansion: A company called John Deere, they have plants, Hy-Tech Engineers Limited September 22, 2026 CIN No. - L99999MH1978PLC020853 almost 8 to 10 plants in Europe and about 47 plants in USA.
And we always keep extra capacity, the reason is that when new OE comes with about 10 crores, 15 crores order, he asks us, "Do you have a capacity?" So, we have to show the capacity to him.
Sir, as per our PPT, our current hydraulic fitting capacity around 483 lakhs pieces per annum, and captive forging capacity around 3,120 metric ton per annum.
Balance sheet & cash: The fresh issue proceeds are being utilized towards the identified objectives, including the capital expenditure, repayment of our borrowings, and general corporate purpose.
So, this clearly shows that we have operating leverage.
Risks & challenges: And it has to withstand very high pressures, so the criticality of manufacturing of this fitting is very, very important, and that is the reason we stand out in the market.

That joint has to sustain that high pressure, and to sustaining that high pressure, the quality of the fitting has to be good, the joints have to be accurate, machining has to be precision, and sealing elements also have to be taken care of.
It has got some standards for withstanding those pressures, and what we have to guarantee to our customers is leak -proofness of this fitting and withstanding to such high pressures.
